All other command substitutions are within functions that are not executed during `makepkg --printsrcinfo`.

The use of `eval` to define package functions occurs after the metadata (pkgname, pkgver, etc.) has been determined and does not affect the safety of the sourcing phase. The overall structure is consistent with complex AUR packaging logic for multi-variant builds and does not contain malicious code that would execute during this step.
